name: capitaldesk
description: Owner-approved shared-account execution coordinator with attributable strategy claims and recoverable order evidence.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter=./packages/* run build && pnpm -r --filter=./apps/* run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm --filter @capitaldesk/web run typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:layering && pnpm run check:secrets && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:property && pnpm run build
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run preflight:integration && tsc -b && pnpm run typecheck:tests && vitest run --project integration
